# Innovators AI HUB

> Innovators AI HUB designs and deploys autonomous AI-Agentic Systems and premium AI Brand Films to accelerate business growth and automate operations.

## Key Offerings

- **AI Agent Teams**: Pre-trained and custom autonomous agents built for WhatsApp, voice calling, LinkedIn outreach, and custom workflows.
- **AI Brand Films**: Cinematic storytelling using advanced generative AI, combining live action and synthetic environments.

## Services & Pricing

Full specifications can be parsed at [/pricing.md](https://innovatorsaihub.com/pricing.md).

- **WhatsApp AI Agent**: Starts at ₹12,000/mo. Automated CRM integration, chat, & lead qualification.
- **Voice Calling AI Agent**: Starts at ₹5,000/mo. Automated outbound calling & support.
- **LinkedIn AI Agent**: Starts at ₹3,000/mo. Automated outreach & appointment setting.
- **Custom AI Workflows**: Custom pricing. Multi-agent collaborative setups for operational scale.
- **AI Brand Films**: Custom pricing. Generative video production.
